01_protected_start.note: Wall and door textures overhauled into one coherent set (bolted steel panels, louvred vents, sliding doors with a hazard band, riveted reactor plates, coolant pipes, recessed hull panels, relay racks), and doors now darken along their own palette order instead of turning bright at distance: only wall and door pixels change; every frame check, including dynamic_tiles_exact against the reference read from VRAM, passes.

03_airlock_open.note: Sable Outpost (sector 1) is redrawn as a named place: the landing airlock, a U-shaped decon passage, the bunk room and mess hall off it, and the comms room where the Sentinel guards the lift, which stands in a machinery frame. The spawn, the airlock door ahead of it, the Sentinel, the exit door and the lift keep their cells, so every pose names the same place; the zig-zag door became the mess hatch (tour captures renamed). Only the world view changes, apart from the helmet blink landing on other captures because update timing moved; every frame check passes.

09_exit_approach.note: Overlapped publication is the slim default: the VBlank interrupt publishes the tail while the next update casts, so updates finish sooner and this living-world capture lands on another accepted simulation tick (a door panel a step further open, an actor or beacon animation frame, the helmet blink, a drop a tick apart).
